meta.method: cuts: original 128 scene cuts + 12 missed hard cuts found by frame-difference re-scan (all verified visually). words: caption OCR per frame-accurate caption segment, hand-verified. move: SIFT similarity transform between frame start+2 and end-3 (zoom=scale ratio, shift = centre displacement as fraction of width/height; shift_x>0 = content moves right = camera pans left). Every shot carries a ~4-5% linear centre zoom-in (editor Ken-Burns); "push_in" therefore is the default.
meta.fields: set/framing/move/pose/face use ARCHITECTURE vocab where possible; free-text poses outside POSES: handstand, eat, water plants; faces outside FACES: none.
